## The Providence Group Earns Multiple 2026 OBIE Awards, Including Master-Planned Community of the Year


November 6, 2026


Download (opens in new window)


*Atlanta homebuilder recognized for community development, home design, marketing, sales leadership and community service*


ATLANTA--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


The Providence Group, a subsidiary of Green Brick Partners, Inc. (NYSE: GRBK), received multiple honors at the Greater Atlanta Home Builders Association’s 2026 OBIE Awards, including the Gold OBIE for Master-Planned Community of the Year for Waterside in Peachtree Corners.


Presented October 24, the awards recognize excellence in new-home construction, community development, sales and marketing throughout Metro Atlanta. The Providence Group was honored across community planning, home design, branding, sales leadership, design leadership, and community service.


*“We are proud to see our team’s work recognized across so many disciplines,” said Dusty Talbert, Director of Marketing for The Providence Group. “These honors reflect the care our teams bring to creating exceptional homes, thoughtfully planned communities and meaningful experiences for our homeowners and neighbors.”*


**2026 OBIE AWARD HONORS**


**Signature Honors**


- Gold OBIE, Master-Planned Community of the Year — Waterside, Peachtree Corners
- Gold OBIE, Best Community Service — West Jackson Elementary School partnership near Aberdeen


**Individual Honors**


- Sales Manager of the Year — Ansley Hayes, Director of Sales. Recognized for leadership of The Providence Group’s metro Atlanta sales efforts and commitment to the homebuying experience.
- Designer of the Year — Terance Manly, Director of Design. Honored for creative leadership across the company’s neighborhoods and model homes, including the 2026 Atlanta St. Jude Dream Home.


**Gold OBIE Awards**


- Best Community Logo — Promenade at Sawnee Village
- Single Family Builder, Detached ($400,000–$499,999) — The Orchid at Aberdeen
- Single Family Builder, Detached ($500,000–$599,999) — The Carter at Palisades
- Luxury Builder Category ($1.2 million–$1.49 million) — The Oakhurst II at Waterside
- Best Building Design, Detached Model ($600,000–$699,999) — The Langston Model at Promenade at Sawnee Village
- Best Building Design, Attached Model ($800,000–$899,999) — The Chamberlain Model at Park Walke
- Single Family Attached ($400,000–$499,999) — The Adams at Waterside


**Silver OBIE Awards**


- Best Building Design, Attached Model ($600,000–$699,999) — The Benton I at IveyBrooke
- Single Family Attached ($399,999 and under) The Magnolia at Market Square at Sawnee Village
- Community of the Year, Attached — IveyBrooke


The 2026 honors continue The Providence Group’s history of recognition for its communities, home designs, marketing and sales achievements. For more information, visit[theprovidencegroup.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Ftheprovidencegroup.com%2F&esheet=54636818&newsitemid=20261106769075&lan=en-US&anchor=theprovidencegroup.com&index=1&md5=72931e05b64755f67ded03338ee76e3d) .


**About The Providence Group**


Celebrating a legacy of over 20 years of success in the homebuilding industry, The Providence Group continues to develop and build award-winning communities fulfilling its mission to provide Lifestyle, Location and Luxury to its growing family of homeowners. Throughout its long history, the company has built well-crafted homes in one-of-a-kind communities in the most sought-after locations in and around Atlanta providing an unsurpassed, low-maintenance lifestyle for residents. Each location is intentionally selected for accessibility and proximity to high-quality school districts, entertainment, shopping and dining options, and every neighborhood is outfitted with amenities tailored for the lifestyle of the area. In 2011, The Providence Group entered into a financial partnership with what ultimately became Green Brick Partners, Inc., a diversified homebuilding and land development company listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol “GRBK”. With Green Brick’s financial and operational support, The Providence Group has been able to combine its local expertise with the financial liquidity of a national, public homebuilder. Visit[theprovidencegroup.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Ftheprovidencegroup.com%2F&esheet=54636818&newsitemid=20261106769075&lan=en-US&anchor=theprovidencegroup.com&index=3&md5=393a73cc4dca84e584509ce362f42b41) . to learn more.


**About Green Brick Partners, Inc.**


Green Brick Partners, Inc. (NYSE: GRBK), the third largest homebuilder in Dallas-Fort Worth, is a diversified homebuilding and land development company that operates through its seven subsidiary homebuilders in Texas, Georgia, and Florida. Green Brick owns five subsidiary homebuilders in Texas (CB JENI Homes, Normandy Homes, Southgate Homes, Trophy Signature Homes, and a 90% interest in Centre Living Homes), as well as a controlling interest in a homebuilder in Atlanta, Georgia (The Providence Group) and an 80% interest in a homebuilder in Port St. Lucie, Florida (GHO Homes). Green Brick also retains interest in related financial services platforms, including Green Brick Title, Green Brick Mortgage, and Green Brick Insurance. Green Brick is engaged in all aspects of the homebuilding process, including land acquisition and development, entitlements, design, construction, marketing, and sales for its residential neighborhoods and master-planned communities. For more information about Green Brick Partners, Inc.’s subsidiary homebuilders, please visit[https://greenbrickpartners.com/brands-services/.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fgreenbrickpartners.com%2Fbrands-services%2F&esheet=54636818&newsitemid=20261106769075&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fgreenbrickpartners.com%2Fbrands-services%2F.&index=2&md5=9556ab2e856172783406789915c9a546)
